20	export class EinsteinAPI {
21	    constructor({host, einsteinId, siteId, isProduction, dnt}) {
22	        this.dnt = dnt
23	        this.siteId = siteId
24	        this.isProduction = isProduction
25	        this.host = host
26	        this.einsteinId = einsteinId
27	    }
28	
29	    /**
30	     * Given a POJO append the correct site and environment values
31	     *
32	     * @param {object} params
33	     * @returns {object} The decorated body object.
34	     */
35	    _buildBody(params) {
36	        const instanceType_prd = 'prd'
37	        const instanceType_sbx = 'sbx'
38	
39	        const body = {...params}
40	
41	        // The first part of the siteId is the realm
42	        if (this.siteId) {
43	            body.realm = this.siteId.split('-')[0]
44	        }
45	
46	        if (this.isProduction) {
47	            body.instanceType = instanceType_prd
48	        } else {
49	            body.instanceType = instanceType_sbx
50	        }
51	
52	        return body
53	    }
54	
55	    /**
56	     * Given a product or item source, returns the product data that Einstein requires
57	     */
58	    _constructEinsteinProduct(product) {
59	        // Handle variants for PDP / viewProduct
60	        // Assumes product is a Product object from SCAPI Shopper-Products:
61	        // https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/commerce/commerce-api/references/shopper-products?meta=type%3AProduct
62	        if (product.type) {
63	            // In case of variant, send the "sku" attribute
64	            if (product.type.variant) {
65	                return {
66	                    id: product.master.masterId,
67	                    price: product.price,
68	                    sku: product.id
69	                }
70	            }
71	
72	            // In case of variation group, send the "altId" and "type" attributes
73	            if (product.type.variationGroup) {
74	                return {
75	                    altId: product.id,
76	                    id: product.master.masterId,
77	                    price: product.price,
78	                    sku: product.id,
79	                    type: 'vgroup'
80	                }
81	            }
82	
83	            // Handle non-variant products, like master, set, bundle, item.
84	            // This code follows the implementation in the plugin_einstein_api.
85	            // https://github.com/SalesforceCommerceCloud/plugin_einstein_api/blob/c8168d5b8e2e34bfb9413da73969d59b0f3adabd/plugin_einstein_api/cartridge/scripts/helpers/RecommendationsHelper.js#L315
86	            return {
87	                id: product.id,
88	                price: product.price
89	            }
90	        }
91	
92	        // Handle variants & sets for PLP / viewCategory & viewSearch
93	        // Assumes product is a ProductSearchHit from SCAPI Shopper-Search:
94	        // https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/commerce/commerce-api/references/shopper-search?meta=type%3AProductSearchHit
95	        if (product.hitType) {
96	            return {
97	                id: product.productId,
98	                sku: product.productId, //TODO: Should we switch this to product.representedProduct.id once we allow non-master products in search results?
99	                altId: '',
100	                altIdType: ''
101	            }
102	        }
103	
104	        // handles non-variants
105	        return {
106	            id: product.id,
107	            sku: '',
108	            altId: '',
109	            altIdType: ''
110	        }
111	    }
112	
113	    /**
114	     * Given a cart item, returns the data that Einstein requires
115	     *
116	     * Assumes item is a ProductItemfrom SCAPI Shopper-Baskets:
117	     * https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/commerce/commerce-api/references/shopper-baskets?meta=type%3AProductItem
118	     *
119	     * This code follows the implementation in the plugin_einstein_api.
120	     * https://github.com/SalesforceCommerceCloud/plugin_einstein_api/blob/c8168d5b8e2e34bfb9413da73969d59b0f3adabd/plugin_einstein_api/cartridge/scripts/helpers/RecommendationsHelper.js#L315
121	     */
122	    _constructEinsteinItem(item) {
123	        const {product, productId, price, quantity} = item
124	
125	        // In case of variant, send the "sku" attribute
126	        if (product?.type?.variant) {
127	            return {
128	                id: product.master.masterId,
129	                quantity: quantity,
130	                price: price,
131	                sku: product.id
132	            }
133	        }
134	
135	        // In case of variation group, send the "altId" and "type" attributes
136	        if (product?.type?.variationGroup) {
137	            return {
138	                id: product.master.masterId,
139	                quantity: quantity,
140	                price: price,
141	                sku: product.id,
142	                type: 'vgroup',
143	                altId: product.id
144	            }
145	        }
146	
147	        // Otherwise send default attributes.
148	        return {
149	            id: productId,
150	            price: price,
151	            quantity: quantity
152	        }
153	    }
154	
155	    async einsteinFetch(endpoint, method, body) {
156	        if (this.dnt !== false) return {}
157	
158	        const headers = {
159	            'Content-Type': 'application/json',
160	            'x-cq-client-id': this.einsteinId
161	        }
162	
163	        if (body) {
164	            body = this._buildBody(body)
165	        }
166	
167	        let response
168	        try {
169	            response = await fetch(`${this.host}/v3${endpoint}`, {
170	                method: method,
171	                headers: headers,
172	                ...(body && {
173	                    body: JSON.stringify(body)
174	                })
175	            })
176	        } catch (error) {
177	            logger.error('Einstein request failed', {
178	                namespace: 'useEinstein.einsteinFetch',
179	                additionalProperties: {error: error}
180	            })
181	            return {}
182	        }
183	
184	        if (!response?.ok) {
185	            return {}
186	        }
187	
188	        try {
189	            const responseJson = await response.json()
190	
191	            return keysToCamel(responseJson)
192	        } catch (error) {
193	            logger.error('Error parsing response JSON', {
194	                namespace: 'useEinstein.einsteinFetch',
195	                additionalProperties: {error: error}
196	            })
197	            return {}
198	        }
199	    }
200	
201	    /**
202	     * Tells the Einstein engine when a user views a product.
203	     * https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/commerce/einstein-api/references#einstein-recommendations:Summary
204	     **/
205	    async sendViewProduct(product, args) {
206	        const endpoint = `/activities/${this.siteId}/viewProduct`
207	        const method = 'POST'
208	        const body = {
209	            product: this._constructEinsteinProduct(product),
210	            ...args
211	        }
212	
213	        return this.einsteinFetch(endpoint, method, body)
214	    }
215	
216	    /**
217	     * Tells the Einstein engine when a user views search results.
218	     **/
219	    async sendViewSearch(searchText, searchResults, args) {
220	        const endpoint = `/activities/${this.siteId}/viewSearch`
221	        const method = 'POST'
222	
223	        const products =
224	            searchResults?.hits?.map((product) => this._constructEinsteinProduct(product)) ?? []
225	
226	        const body = {
227	            searchText,
228	            products,
229	            showProducts: Boolean(products.length), // Needed by Reports and Dashboards to differentiate searches with results vs no results
230	            ...args
231	        }
232	
233	        return this.einsteinFetch(endpoint, method, body)
234	    }
235

237	     * Tells the Einstein engine when a user clicks on a search result.
238	     **/
239	    async sendClickSearch(searchText, product, args) {
240	        const endpoint = `/activities/${this.siteId}/clickSearch`
241	        const method = 'POST'
242	        const body = {
243	            searchText,
244	            product: this._constructEinsteinProduct(product),
245	            ...args
246	        }
247	
248	        return this.einsteinFetch(endpoint, method, body)
